headline: Franchises in Puebla Will Raise Prices by 5 to 10% Due to Rising Raw Material Costs
summary: Franchise operators in Puebla will raise prices by 5 to 10 percent because of rising raw material costs. The Mexican Franchise Network's vice president said the alternative risks businesses with low sales.
why: Franchises are a major part of Mexico's retail and food service sector, and price increases pass cost pressures to consumers. Input costs influence inflation and margins for consumer businesses.
original_headline: Franquicias de Puebla subirán precios entre 5 y 10% por encarecimiento de materias primas
